packageRules.description: morphir-elm 2.100.0 crashes with a fatal EBADF fd-close-on-GC after successful generation (bead morphir-qki); later releases are welcome

A Java major update needs a person. One java-jdk value feeds both setup-java (Temurin) and setup-graalvm, and GraalVM Community does not release every JDK major: the update to 26 (#1060) gave setup-graalvm a Temurin build string it cannot download, and it merged while the ci gate was failing
